text:
Your alma is encontrará sola, cautiva of the
negros pensamientos of the gris piedra tumbal;
ninguna persona you inquietará in your horas of
recogimiento.


                            ——


Quédate silenciosamente in esa soledad that
not is abandono,—because the espíritus of the
muertos that existieron antes that tú in the life,
you alcanzarán and you rodearán in the death,—and
the shadow proyectada over your cara obedecerá
a his voluntad; for it tanto, permanece tranquilo.


                            ——


Aunque serena, the night fruncirá his ceño,
and the estrellas, of it alto of his tronos celestes,
not bajarán more his miradas with a resplandor
parecido to the of the esperanza that is concede a
the mortales; but his órbitas rojas, desprovistas
of all rayo, serán for your heart marchito
as a quemadura, as a fiebre
that querrá unirse a ti for siempre.


                            ——


Now, you visitan pensamientos that not ahuyentarás
jamás; now surgen ante ti visiones
that not is desvanecerán jamás; jamás ellas dejarán
your espíritu, but is fijarán as gotas
of rocío over the hierba.


                            ——


The brisa,—esa respiración of God,—reposa
inmóvil, and the bruma that is extiende as a
shadow over the colina,—as a shadow cuyo
velo not is ha desgarrado todavía,—resulta así
a símbolo and a signo. As logra permanecer
suspendida a the árboles, ese is the misterio
of the misterios!

translation.title: The espíritus of the muertos
